import { Callout } from '@/components/docs/docs-callout';
import { DocsAgentIndex } from '@/components/docs/docs-agent-index';

<DocsAgentIndex />

Use this page to confirm which rails and currencies you can offer before you pick an integration path. For per-channel flows, see the [payment channel guides](/build/payment-methods/wave).

<Callout type="info">
  Exact availability depends on your organization's enabled providers in the dashboard. Contact support if a channel you need is not active.
</Callout>

## Recommended path by channel

| Channel | Hosted checkout / links | Direct API | Deep dive |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Cards | Yes | `POST /charge/card` | [Cards](/build/payment-methods/cards) |
| Wave | Yes | `POST /charge/wave` | [Wave](/build/payment-methods/wave) |
| MTN MoMo | Yes | `POST /charge/mtn` | [MTN MoMo](/build/payment-methods/mtn-momo) |
| SPI | Yes (hosted) | Prefer hosted | [SPI](/build/payment-methods/spi) |

**Default:** hosted checkout or payment links. Direct charges when you own the payment UI and understand rail-specific async behavior.

## Markets and currencies

| Region / focus | Primary currencies | Mobile money | Cards |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| UEMOA (Wave-first) | `XOF` | Wave | Yes |
| MTN MoMo countries | `XOF`, `XAF`, `GHS`, `UGX`, `ZMW`, `NGN`, `ZAR`, … | MTN MoMo | Yes (where enabled) |
| International cards | `USD`, `EUR` (product-dependent) | — | Yes |

## MTN MoMo — supported countries

| --- | --- | --- |
| Côte d'Ivoire (CI) | `+225` | `mtnivorycoast` |

| Ghana (GH) | `+233` | `mtnghana` |
| Uganda (UG) | `+256` | `mtnuganda` |

## Test vs live

| | Test | Live |
| --- | --- | --- |
| API base | `https://sandbox.api.lomi.africa` | `https://api.lomi.africa` |
| MTN direct charge | Often `completed` immediately | `PENDING` until customer approves |
| Webhooks | `environment: "test"` | `environment: "live"` |
